import math
import unittest

import solution


class EvaluateExpressionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_arithmetic_operand_order_and_float_result(self):
        tokens = [10, 3, "-", 2, "/"]
        variables = {}
        result = solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, variables)
        self.assertEqual(result, 3.5)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, float)

    def test_variables(self):
        self.assertEqual(solution.evaluate_expression(["x", "y", "*", 2, "+"], {"x": 4, "y": 2.5}), 12.0)

    def test_success_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        tokens = [2, 3, "+"]
        variables = {"x": 9}
        solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, variables)
        self.assertEqual(tokens, [2, 3, "+"])
        self.assertEqual(variables, {"x": 9})

    def test_failure_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
        tokens = [1, "missing", "+"]
        variables = {"known": 2}
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, variables)
        self.assertEqual(tokens, [1, "missing", "+"])
        self.assertEqual(variables, {"known": 2})

    def test_container_type_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            solution.evaluate_expression((1,), {})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            solution.evaluate_expression([], [])

    def test_bad_token_and_variable_types(self):
        cases = [
            ([True], {}),
            ([object()], {}),
            ([1], {1: 2}),
            ([1], {"x": True}),
        ]
        for tokens, variables in cases:
            with self.subTest(tokens=tokens, variables=variables):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, variables)

    def test_value_errors(self):
        cases = [
            ([], {}),
            ([1, 2], {}),
            ([1, "+"], {}),
            ([""], {}),
            (["unknown"], {}),
            ([math.inf], {}),
            ([1], {"": 2}),
            ([1], {"x": math.nan}),
        ]
        for tokens, variables in cases:
            with self.subTest(tokens=tokens, variables=variables):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, variables)

    def test_division_by_zero(self):
        tokens = [1, 0, "/"]
        with self.assertRaises(ZeroDivisionError):
            solution.evaluate_expression(tokens, {})
        self.assertEqual(tokens, [1, 0, "/"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
